senses.gloss: sthera (= sthavira, cf. thera; Pali thera), old; an elder: sthero na tāvatā bhavati (pronounce bhoti) Ud 〔xi.11〕 (required by meter; later v.l. sthaviro, unmetr); sthero ti ucyate 〔xi.12〕 (later v.l. sthavira ucyate, where meter is preserved by omitting the MIndic ti = iti). The first of these corresp. to Pali Dhp. 〔260〕 na tena thero hoti, where meter requires either thaviro, or with vv.ll. bhavati, or so hoti.
